summary: Listed only in one Georgia lookout index as a Stephens County tower at 34.65910, -83.33748; no build, fate or site record found.

evidence.supports: Index lists a lookout named black mtn in Stephens County with its coordinates
Index is a list of Georgia lookout towers
Index also lists a separate Black Mountain Look Out Tower in Union County

notes_for_editor: Story is about 52 words, well under the 120-word floor, because the only source is one index row. Its elevation column has no unit label, so the brief's 469.1 m was not used. The National Historic Lookout Register Georgia list (29 entries) has no Stephens County tower, and the Forest Fire Lookout Association Georgia page says its data are still being compiled. Keep this record separate from us-ga-black-mountain-look-out (Union County), which is roughly 60 km west. Recommend holding this record from publication until a second source turns up.
